def transform(grid):
    # Copy the non-background pattern into the zero rectangle, mirrored left-to-right.
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    cells=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (bg,0)]
    if not cells: return g
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
    zr=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==0]
    zc=[c for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==0]
    if not zr or not zc: return g
    tr0,tr1=min(zr),max(zr); tc0,tc1=min(zc),max(zc)
    for r in range(tr0,tr1+1):
        for c in range(tc0,tc1+1):
            sr=r0+(r-tr0); sc=c1-(c-tc0)

                v=grid[sr][sc]
                if v!=bg: g[r][c]=v
                else: g[r][c]=min(set(vv for row in grid for vv in row if vv not in (bg,0)))
